# Swagger P2 Site

> Builds an Eclipse P2 repository (update site) that wraps `io.swagger:swagger-core:1.5.24` and its transitive dependencies as OSGi bundles for Eclipse-based applications.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4 (via Maven Wrapper)
- Single-module packaging project — no Java source code, no submodules
- Uses p2-maven-plugin 2.0.0 to generate P2 metadata from Maven artifacts
- Packages P2 site as ZIP via maven-assembly-plugin
- Deploys to JUDO Nexus, Maven Central (Sonatype), and JUDO Nexus P2 site via WebDAV
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project introduction, architecture diagram, quick start, and deployment profiles
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Full developer guide with build commands, directory structure, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development environment setup, branching strategy, and submission guidelines

## Build Configuration

- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Root POM with plugins, profiles, deployment targets, and CI-friendly `${revision}` versioning
- [src/assembly/assembly.xml](src/assembly/assembly.xml): Assembly descriptor for ZIP packaging of the P2 repository
- [.mvn/extensions.xml](.mvn/extensions.xml): Wagon extensions for file and WebDAV deployment transport
